actions: Remove the static main-window declaration from tauri.conf.json
Require foreground startup and tray-open to create the main window dynamically in Rust
Ensure --background reaches Tauri setup without creating the main WebView window
records.reason: LB-013 requires --background to create no visible/main window from process entry; the inherited static tauri.conf.json window would be created before Rust could hide it, which violates the frozen background lifecycle contract.
records.evidence_ref: Standing user authorization permits concrete executor pre-authorizations with later audit; LB-013 contract requires '--background no visible window' and docs/02_ARCHITECTURE_RUNTIME.md requires entry-time background mode rather than create-then-hide.

actions: Add staged shutdown primitives that stop Tunnel first and retain PEP/MCP ownership
Allow the desktop exit coordinator to close the privileged call gate and stop Broker between Tunnel shutdown and PEP/MCP shutdown
Keep RuntimeOrchestrator::stop() externally compatible by composing the same staged shutdown primitives
records.reason: The frozen privileged lifecycle requires Tray Exit ordering Tunnel -> privileged request gate closed -> Broker -> PEP -> MCP. The existing monolithic RuntimeOrchestrator::stop() performs Tunnel -> PEP -> MCP without an insertion point for Broker shutdown, so the production lifecycle could not satisfy the documented security ordering.
records.evidence_ref: Standing user authorization permits concrete executor pre-authorizations with later audit; docs/12_PRIVILEGED_BROKER.md freezes Tray Exit as Tunnel then privileged gate/Broker then PEP then MCP, while current RuntimeOrchestrator::stop() is monolithic.

actions: Add an owned CredentialStore path to ProductionRuntimeDriver while preserving the existing borrowed constructor for prior G2 tests
Add only a cfg(test) ready-runtime constructor needed to exercise shutdown against actual production MCP/PEP/Tunnel adapter handles
records.reason: G3 adversarial review commit fc9f4eb found that DesktopLifecycle could not own the borrowed ProductionRuntimeDriver as a long-lived production runtime, leaving Tray Exit with runtime=None even when the frozen lifecycle requires Tunnel -> privileged gate/Broker -> PEP -> MCP cleanup.
records.evidence_ref: Review fc9f4eb and current source show DesktopLifecycle::register_runtime had no production caller and ProductionRuntimeDriver borrowed CredentialStore; this preauthorization is limited to making that adapter ownable and testable without broadening LB-013 writable paths.
